home.createSub: Generates a room code and waits for members
home.joinSub: Enter or paste a room code
home.empty: Rooms on the same WiFi appear here automatically. Nothing to do.
room.shareHint: On the same WiFi use the LAN address. For a friend elsewhere, probe the public address first, then send them the invite.
room.needMap: Public access needs UDP {local} forwarded to this machine on your router; without a mapping only the same network can join.
room.mapHint: Public port {pub}, local port {local}. If they differ, forward external {pub} to local {local} on your router.
room.guide: How to play together in Minecraft
guide.1: In your single-player world press Esc and choose ‘Open to LAN’
guide.2: Friends open Minecraft multiplayer and this world appears in their list automatically
guide.3: Click to join and play — exactly like a real LAN
join.title: Join a room
join.hint: Enter the room code your friend shared, or paste the full text (parsed automatically).
log.endpoint: Found the host’s public endpoint, handshake sent
join.errTitle: Connection failed: invalid room code or unreachable host
join.errBody: Check the code and address with the host. A remote connection usually fails because UDP is not forwarded to the host's machine — forward the room port on the host router, or use the same LAN.
tr.title: Transfer
tr.notInRoom: Join a room to send files
tr.notInRoomSub: Create or join a room on the Room page; files travel directly between members.
tr.pickHint: Sends as soon as you pick; contents are encrypted with the room key end to end.
tr.offersSub: The sender is waiting for your answer
tr.noMember: No other members in the room yet
set.title: Settings
set.themeHint: Light and dark are maintained in lockstep
set.navHint: Sidebar or top bar; your choice is remembered
set.customBody: — every interface color comes from theme tokens; imported theme packs apply instantly
set.themeSeedHint: Type a hex value or tap the circle button
set.themeWeightHint: Apply emphasized type weights across the whole UI
set.themeFontHint: Text and mono fonts can be changed.
set.themeI18nHint: Add an i18n field in JSON to provide a theme name for each language.
set.themeManageBody: Seed color, fonts, text size and corner radius. All changes apply instantly.
set.name: Username
set.nameHint: Defaults to your system username; editable
set.autostartHint: Runs in the background after you sign in
set.stunHint: Contacted only for a manual check; game data never passes through it
set.stunNote: A custom server can only reveal your public address; it cannot read your traffic. Use only a server you trust — a wrong setting can slow connections down.
set.permAdminHint: Running as administrator; hosting, joining and firewall rules are available
set.permUserHint: Hosting and joining have the background core create the virtual adapter and firewall rules; only the core is elevated, the UI stays as a normal app
set.permBusyHint: A room is active; leave it before restarting
set.permDone: Now running the core as administrator
set.portHint: UDP port used for network play. Change it if it conflicts; default 47777.
set.mtuHint: Maximum transmission unit of the virtual adapter. Default 1400. If some games fail to connect, try 1500 or 1200.
set.licenseHint: This project uses Apache-2.0. Third-party components: zxing2 (BSD-3-Clause), image (MIT), wintun (BSD-3-Clause)
ob.w2: Create a room and send the code to your friends —
ob.w3: everyone’s game will think you are all on the same LAN.
ob.p2: Playing together requires a virtual network adapter on this machine so games can see a “LAN”. Creating it needs one admin approval.
ob.b1: The virtual adapter routes only the 10.66.x.x room address range; everyday traffic never touches this app
ob.b2: All game data is end-to-end encrypted; no third party can read it
ob.b3: No fixed servers, zero telemetry, open source and auditable
ob.r2: Create a room, or enter a code to join a friend’s room.
ob.r3: Rooms on the same WiFi appear on the home page automatically.
qr.title: Scan to join
qr.hint: Scan with the EGLAN client to join room {room}
proto.title: EGLAN prototype v3
proto.hint: This control bar exists only in the prototype, not in the real app
join.peerHint: Host's IP:port — pasting an invite fills this in
room.notInRoom: You are not in a room
room.emptyBody: Create a room and send the code to friends, or join with a code you received.
err.stunReply: The STUN reply contained no usable address
err.bridgeMissing: Core binary egland.exe not found. Put it next to the UI, or in the repo's dist folder
err.elevateTimeout: The elevated core did not connect in time; the normal core was restored
err.coreNotRunning: The core process is not running
qr.decodeFail: No QR code found. Try a clearer image.
qr.unavailable: Room details are not ready yet; the QR code is unavailable
